input.message: Dear Ruben, about the broken washing machine at Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane, Eastmere. Your landlord has confirmed he is happy for you to replace the machine with your own, and for it to remain your property and leave with you at the end of the tenancy. He also agreed to cover a removal charge for the old machine if one arises; you have told us your brother will take it to the tip instead, so we are not arranging a removal — if that changes, contact us before you pay anything. Two things please: (1) let us know once the old machine is out and your own machine is installed, so we can close this request and update the inventory; (2) a safety point — if anything at the property other than the machine itself is involved, for example the socket or plug is scorched or smells burnt, the fuse board or RCD trips when the machine is plugged in, or there are sparks, stop using that socket and tell us straight away, as the property's electrics are the landlord's responsibility and we would arrange an electrician. If your new machine needs plumbing or electrical connection work, please use a competent installer. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings.
